contrast: internal: vectors were extracted in two families (anger/joy/sadness and disgust/fear/surprise), each contrasted within its own family. AUCs across families are therefore not directly comparable.
notes: anger, joy, sadness were extracted with ~3030 balanced samples per class.
disgust, fear, surprise were extracted with 663 balanced samples per class (capped by disgust which has only 1 GoEmotions sub-label).
Best contiguous 3-layer window for anger/joy/sadness: [20, 21, 22] (mean micro-AUC 0.847).

Best contiguous 3-layer window for disgust/fear/surprise: [16, 17, 18] (mean micro-AUC 0.860). Vectors saved here at [20, 21, 22] for endpoint compatibility — slightly off-optimum (mean micro-AUC 0.846).
Surprise has the largest norms; α >= 1.5 produces degenerate output. Drop to ~0.75 for clean effect.
